text:
Anna: Hey team — noticed routing headers (routing_decision) aren't showing up in trace details in the Console for a few EU customers. Example we inject: `X-Redwood-Routing: tier=premium;region=eu-west;model=redwood-7b-quant-v1`

Raj: Can you paste the raw curl or a dev trace id? which console page (Request > Trace or Model > Requests)?

Anna: repro curl below, trace id redacted: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \\
  -H \"X-Redwood-Routing: tier=premium;region=eu-west;model=redwood-7b-quant-v1;decision_id=dec_1234\" \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}'
```

Marco: My guess: the internal proxy (envoy/nginx) is stripping the header or we aren't mapping it into our trace schema on the ingestion side. Two quick wins: (1) canonical header name `X-RW-Routing` to avoid collision with customer headers, (2) include a decision_id and version so we can store a tiny pointer instead of full blob.

Sasha: Important: do NOT put PII in that header. No tenant names, user emails, prompts, or customer IDs. If we need linkage, use a hashed tenant id or an opt-in mapping. GDPR note: any header that can be linked to an individual must be treated same as logs.

Design-Aya: UX ask: when a user inspects a trace, we want a small \"Decision card\" in the top-right of the trace pane showing: tier, selected_variant, fallback_chain (collapsed), decision_reason, decision_id + copy button. Clicking expands to show config snapshot and rollout flags.

Terry: Telemetry cost: we can't persist full trace objects for all requests. Proposal: full-trace retention policy per tier: premium 100% full capture (90d), pro 10% full capture, free 0.5% full capture; others -> event-only (counters). Also emit aggregated metrics: fallback_rate_by_tier, avg_latency_by_route, selected_variant_distribution.

Anna: Also want quota context in the card: quota_bucket, tokens_remaining_at_request, and whether routing was influenced by quota. That makes debugging easier for support.

Raj: On the API/ingest side we'll add structured fields to the trace envelope instead of parsing free-form headers. Proposed trace envelope additions: `routing_policy_version`, `decision_id`, `selected_variant`, `fallback_reason` (enum: none, capacity, latency_slo, cost_limit, model_error), `decision_weight` (float), `region`, `tier`. Ingestion will map `X-RW-Routing` -> these fields.

Marco: Implementation note: avoid storing the whole candidate list inline for sampled events only. For full captures, store candidate_variants as an array. For events-only we keep summary: num_candidates + top_candidates.

ops-bot: deploy 1976123678: patched routing header passthrough on edge proxies (:rocket:)

Sasha: Also add per-tenant logging opt-out. Some enterprise customers require that routing metadata not be exported to third-party observability systems. We need a per-tenant flag to redact or hash routing headers before export.

Design-Aya: Will create 2 mockups: compact card + expanded panel. Compact includes small reason tag (e.g., \"latency SLO\") and a colored dot for fallback severity. Expanded shows the fallback chain and policy version. Also a tiny CTA: \"Explain why\" that shows step-by-step playback of decision weights.

Terry: Storage sizing quick calc: if we sample 10% of pro and store ~2KB extra per trace we get ~X TB/month — I'll put numbers in the ticket. Also we should TTL raw candidate lists after 30d unless customer requests longer.

Anna: Action list: (1) Marco -> PR for canonical header + header schema (X-RW-Routing) by EOD, (2) Raj -> ingestion mapping + metrics (fallback_rate_by_tier, fallback_type_breakdown) + sampling config, (3) Design-Aya -> mockups + tooltip copy, (4) Terry -> storage sizing & retention proposal, (5) Sasha -> add privacy gating/tenant opt-out flag. I'll open a tracker and link mockups.

Raj: Quick question on sampling: suggested defaults?

Marco: My rough defaults: premium 5%, pro 0.5%, free 0.05% for full-trace capture, with event-level metrics always emitted.

Terry: For initial rollout I'd push premium to 10% for 2 weeks to catch regressions during model swaps, then drop back. Agree on higher sample for canaries.

Anna: Sounds good. I'll file as RFC and tag eng-platform + product.

Marco: small config snippet for header format we discussed:
```
X-RW-Routing: decision_id=dec_1234;policy_v=2026-03-18;tier=premium;region=eu-west;selected_variant=redwood-7b-qv1;fallback_reason=none
```
(ingest maps to fields: decision_id, policy_v, tier, region, selected_variant, fallback_reason)

Sasha: :thumbsup: keep it minimal. No prompt text. Hash tenant id if present.

Design-Aya: I'll add the \"Why this route?\" tooltip copy: \"Shows the policy evaluation that selected this model variant. Includes active rollout flags, weights, and any fallback triggers.\"

Anna: Thanks all — follow-ups in the RFC. :white_check_mark:
